title: Artificer interference sweep
description: The machine-readable answer to whether a mechanism clears itself through its travel, rather than in one pose: the assembly stepped through a motion, every pair measured at every step, stopping at the first step where two bodies share space. A step is where every body sits at one position of the mechanism; the kernel does not interpret the driver values it is given, so a sweep runs over poses from a joint solver, a recording or a file alike. Produced by `api::sweep::interference_sweep`. schema_version 1.

subjects.description: The bodies swept, in the order they were given. Every step's placements are in this order.

steps_offered.description: How many positions the caller supplied.

steps_measured.description: How many were measured. Fewer than were offered when a collision stopped the sweep or it was cancelled, and the difference is the part of the travel nothing is known about.

pairs.description: Every unordered pair, at the step it came closest, worst first.

failing.description: How many pairs the profile calls too close at their tightest step. Absent, or zero, when the sweep passes or was never judged.

cancelled.description: Whether the sweep stopped because it was cancelled. A cancelled sweep proves nothing about the steps it never reached.

tier.description: exact: every body swept is planar throughout, so its facets are its surfaces. approximate: at least one surface is curved and its facets are chords of it, so a measured gap is never smaller than the true gap and never larger than it by more than the pair's `bound`.

drivers.description: The joint coordinates that put the mechanism in this position, as the caller supplied them.

distance.description: The closest the two bodies ever came, in millimetres.

step.description: The step that reading was taken at.

collision.description: Where the sweep first found two bodies sharing space, which is also where it stopped. Absent when the mechanism cleared itself through every step measured.

profile.description: The fit the sweep was judged against. Absent when it only measured.
